How many pounds of chemicals went into landfills in Pennsylvania in 2021?
SELECT sum(try_cast(_57_551_landfills AS double)) AS landfill_pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _8_st = 'PA' AND cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2021'
Which states have the most inventors named first on patent applications?
SELECT inventor_region_code, count(*) AS first_inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_country_code = 'US' AND first_named_inventor = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the consumer price index for all items change from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SA0' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') ORDER BY year
Which federal agencies have barred the most companies from contracting?
SELECT excluding_agency, count(*) AS exclusions FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions WHERE classification <> 'Individual' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the earliest patent in the library with "airplane" in its title?
SELECT patent_id, patent_title, patent_date FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE lower(patent_title) LIKE '%airplane%' ORDER BY patent_date LIMIT 5
Which hospitals in Westchester County treated the most heart attack patients?

SELECT facility_name, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Westchester' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%myocardial infarction%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the most rooftop solar ever estimated at one time in New York's Capital zone?
SELECT max(try_cast(mw_value AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_btm_solar_btmestimatedactual WHERE zone_name = 'CAPITL'
Which states have the most sections of law in the library?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average weekly wage for private-sector workers in Brooklyn in the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT avg_wkly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36047' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1'
Which formal enforcement tools does EPA use most in water permit cases?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which sections of California law were amended most recently?
SELECT citation, try_cast(last_amended_year AS integer) AS last_amended FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'ca' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many formal water enforcement settlements were entered each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS settlements FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions WHERE substr(settlement_entered_date, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which offices appeared on the most ballots in North Carolina in 2020?

SELECT office, count(DISTINCT precinct) AS precincts FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NORTH CAROLINA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many contract opportunities did the Department of Veterans Affairs post for work in New York in 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE departmentindagency LIKE 'VETERANS AFFAIRS%' AND popstate = 'NY' AND posteddate LIKE '2025%'
How many software developers work in the United States, and what do they earn?
SELECT occ_title, tot_emp, a_median FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE area_title = 'U.S.' AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' AND occ_title = 'Software Developers' LIMIT 5
How many clinicians are affiliated with dialysis facilities?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_facility_affiliation WHERE facility_type = 'Dialysis facility'
Which industry codes are listed most often as the primary business of SAM.gov registrants?
SELECT primary_naics, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of trademark registrations cancelled change from 2010 to 2024?
SELECT substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which health and welfare rates appear most often in service contract wage determinations?
SELECT health_welfare, count(*) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do more inventors on U.S. applications come from Japan or from Germany?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_country_code IN ('JP', 'DE') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
How many GAO reports were published in 1999?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND date LIKE '1999%'
Which California cities appear most often as inventor locations on granted patents?
SELECT raw_city, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country = 'US' AND raw_state = 'CA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rules did the EPA list in the spring 2024 regulatory agenda?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rin) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE publication_id = '202404' AND acronym LIKE '%EPA%'
Which parent companies own the most toxic-release reporting facilities?
SELECT _17_standard_parent_co_name, count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _17_standard_parent_co_name <> 'NA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospital cost reports from 1995 are in the library?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '1995'
What share of medical device reports involve an injury rather than a malfunction?
SELECT event_type, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many papers are indexed under Alzheimer Disease?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Alzheimer Disease'
What share of working residents of the Bronx earned $1,250 a month or less in 2019?

SELECT sum(ce01) AS low_wage, sum(c000) AS all_workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'ny' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '36005'
How many Form 4 reports did Tesla insiders file in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE issuertradingsymbol = 'TSLA' AND document_type = '4' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2022'
Which counties in New York have the highest median household income?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_income FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.variable = 'B19013_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies filed an electric quarterly report for the second quarter of 2016?
SELECT count(DISTINCT company_id_ferc) AS companies FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_quarterly_identity WHERE year_quarter = '2016q2'
Which New York counties have the highest average rent paid by subsidized tenants?

SELECT name, try_cast(rent_per_month AS double) AS rent_per_month FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE states = 'NY New York' AND program_label = 'Summary of All HUD Programs' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many wind turbines went into service each year from 2013 to 2022?
SELECT p_year, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE try_cast(p_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which countries outside the United States produce the most patented inventions?
SELECT raw_country, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country <> 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has Veterans Affairs contract spending in Florida changed from 2018 to 2025?

SELECT action_date_fiscal_year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'FL' AND action_date_fiscal_year BETWEEN '2018' AND '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are based outside the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_country_code <> 'USA'
Did Maryland or Virginia get more federal contract dollars in fiscal year 2019?

SELECT primary_place_of_performance_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code IN ('MD', 'VA') AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2019' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states have the highest median gross rent?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_rent FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.variable = 'B25064_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal contract actions went to companies in Buffalo in fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(recipient_city_name) = 'BUFFALO' AND recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025'
Which company officers and directors sold the most shares of their own company in 2024?

SELECT o.rptownername, sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double)) AS shares_sold FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_reportingowner o ON o.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'S' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median household income in Kings County, New York, in the 2020 to 2024 American Community Survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36047' AND variable = 'B19013_E001'
How many people filed to run for president in 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'P' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Where do medical device problems happen most often: hospitals, homes or clinics?
SELECT event_location, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people died in traffic crashes in Texas in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Texas' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which Oklahoma counties host the most turbines?
SELECT t_county, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'OK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What are the ten most recent CRS reports with student loans in the title?
SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND lower(title) LIKE '%student loan%' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 10
What do owners of the 2015 Ford F-150 complain about most?
SELECT compdesc, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'FORD' AND modeltxt = 'F-150' AND cast(yeartxt AS varchar) = '2015' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who ran for the U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania in 2024?
SELECT DISTINCT cand_name, cand_pty_affiliation FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'S' AND cand_office_st = 'PA' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Which New York grid zones produce the most rooftop solar?
SELECT zone_name, sum(try_cast(mw_value AS double)) AS mw_hours FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_btm_solar_btmestimatedactual GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were total reported greenhouse gas emissions, in tons of carbon dioxide equivalent, in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission WHERE year = '2022'
What kinds of legal documents does the law collection hold most?
SELECT document_type, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Labor Department rules about overtime have appeared on the regulatory agenda?
SELECT DISTINCT rin, rule_title FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE acronym LIKE '%DOL%' AND lower(rule_title) LIKE '%overtime%' LIMIT 10
Which car makes draw the most owner complaints to federal safety regulators?
SELECT maketxt, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies based outside the United States file financial statements with the SEC?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE countryba <> 'US'
Which countries do inventors on U.S. patent applications come from most often?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many water discharge inspections were carried out by EPA itself rather than a state?
SELECT count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections WHERE state_epa_flag = 'E'
What did the Department of Defense buy most in Hawaii in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'HI' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which counties in Florida have the oldest median age?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US12%' AND a.variable = 'B01002_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Navy contract dollars in Virginia went to small businesses in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'VA' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which European countries get the most out of their onshore wind on average?
SELECT country, avg(try_cast(cf AS double)) AS avg_capacity_factor FROM govblock_energy.wind_entsoe_pecd_pecd_country_onshore GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies received the most federal contract money for work in Alaska in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'AK' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which drugs cost Medicare Part D the most in New York?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT gnrc_name, sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Where do New York hospital patients go after they are discharged?
SELECT patient_disposition, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which agencies bought the most from small businesses in New York last fiscal year?

SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size = 'SMALL BUSINESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do federal campaigns spend money on most, by category?
SELECT category_desc, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
